# Daniel Bajenov's Portfolio

A personal portfolio website showcasing my skills, experience, and education as a Software Development student at Sheridan College.

## Features

- Responsive design
- About Me section
- Skills and experience showcase
- Education details
- Project links
- Contact information

## Technologies Used

- HTML5
- CSS3
- JavaScript
- Font Awesome for icons
- Vercel for hosting and analytics

## Deployment

This site is deployed on Vercel with Speed Insights enabled for performance monitoring.
